top_signals.title: The Potential Benefits of a Regional Citizens’ Advisory Council for Our Gulf Coast Energy Industry
top_signals.summary: When the EXXON VALDEZ ran aground in Prince William Sound on March 24, 1989, it was an action-forcing event that led to what was the most substantial overhaul of our federal oil spill prevention, preparedness, and response regime in the Nation’s history.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
